notes.title: Royal Idiots going Free to Play
notes.content:
I am going to make Royal Idiots free to play. Recently my hard drive containing the game died, and I no longer have access to any of the projects on it. Therefore I can no longer update the game, so I would like to make it free to anyone who wants to play.

I did have a few updates I would have like to implemented which is unfortunate.
I would have liked to add more game modes and maps, weapons, character customization, and optimization as well.

I do appreciate the support I have gotten in the meantime, and to those of you who have paid for the game I would like to thank you. If I ever make a follow up game ( Like Royal Idiots 2 ) I will make it free from the start. Seeing as this is my first multiplayer game I have made I'd say I did a decent job for what it is, and I hope everyone who has played / will play agrees.

notes.title: Hammer Bug
notes.content: In the last update you couldnt use the hammer in multiplayer, so I fixed that

notes.title: Added weaponry
notes.content: Added a Bo Staff that lets you vault high in the air, as well as a hammer that you can use to crush anybody in your way

notes.title: Singleplayer Zombies Game Mode
notes.content: As of right now, nobody is ever on the game so I added a singleplayer game mode so you can at least play something. Its kind of badly done, but its still decently fun to play. If its something the community wants, Ill update it in the future and make it better!
